parent.text:
MiniMax-H3 × Kijai LightX2V、シーン展開やってみた！！！

ImageGenで作った開始フレームを使って、車・スポーツ・イラスト・バトルを同じI2V条件で生成。
RTX 4090 · Docker Compose · 1344×768 · 4 steps · LoRA 0.75。

4本とも成功、OOMなし、blackdetect=0。概要動画にまとめたぞ🔥

media.provenance: HyperFrames render from four real RTX 4090 Docker Compose outputs; no replacement media

replies.text:
【Scene 1｜車 / I2V】

Prompt:
Animate the supplied sports car start frame into a cinematic high-speed mountain-road shot. Preserve the car design, road composition, and mountain background, add controlled forward camera movement, subtle wheel rotation, realistic reflections, and natural road motion, no text.

Parameters:
GPU: RTX 4090 / Compose: h3-4090
Resolution: 1344×768, 158 frames, 24fps
Base: minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
Text encoder: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
VAE: official FP16 video + FP32 audio
Kijai full LoRA: strength 0.75
Steps: 4 / Sampler: sa_solver / Scheduler: simple
EasyCache: reuse 0.3 / start 0.2 / end 0.9
Seed: 2026080803
Input: MiniMax_H3_I2V_scene_car_imagegen_start.png (AA18AB747483D6761E897456EED5F12CFB82402CC891B64484893D1AEF5A8B0A)

Result:
Comfy execution 209.579 sec / runner wall 210.402 sec
Output 6.583333 sec / H.264 + AAC stereo
OOMなし / blackdetect 0
Output SHA-256: 468D9FB859757B6AEB141950A97737D7C3F713FDD426122A40560A2920EBB062
Benchmark: h3-38166d06-cdd1-4f48-94fc-4fa381cc7d32.md
